summary: Revision 1 (PR #77, closed without merge) produced an otherwise useful article, but Director review found three residual source-boundary violations. Revision 2 reconstructs the full sound revision-1 article and bookkeeping against current main and makes exactly three bounded corrections: (1) removed the finger-zone identification/FAQ cutoff ('well past the territory below the index finger') and replaced it with comparative-only phrasing ('travels conspicuously far across the upper palm relative to the hand being observed'), keeping Benham's entire-hand example as a named historical extreme rather than a modern threshold; (2) removed the unsupported tradition-wide negative-consensus claim that Benham's reading is 'not... a view shared across palmistry traditions as a whole', replaced with evidence-bounded scope language stating the article establishes only Benham's reading and does not claim broader consensus either way; (3) reworded the two endpoint-separation passages that overreached into an unsupported categorical claim ('can be long and still end in any of those/the endpoint positions'), keeping length and endpoint as separate, independently-noted observations without the categorical extension. All sound revision-1 work (observation sections, Benham attribution, safety exclusions, myths, remaining FAQ answers, reciprocal link from heart-line.md, editorial-backlog/CHANGELOG bookkeeping) is preserved unchanged; scope was not broadened.
verification: npm run content-audit (67 blog posts, 25 lessons valid)
npm run audit:all (links incl. no-orphan check, images, schema, indexability, accessibility all pass)

manual grep of final article for prevalence/consensus terms, fixed-cutoff/finger-zone terms, negative-consensus wording, and endpoint-categorical-overreach phrasing: only the intentional disclaiming sentence in 'Length in context' matched, no unauthorized wording remained

source_preflight.notes: Full claim-by-claim disposition of the three revision-2 corrections, plus re-verification that all preserved revision-1 claims remain grounded solely in Benham (1900), Line of Heart chapter, is recorded in docs/source-verification-log.md under 'Long Heart Line Meaning companion article, revision 2'. Re-read the complete article end to end against the full source-boundary checklist (prevalence/consensus, historical/scientific assertions, invented combinations, vague authority, quotation fidelity, claim-type separation, safety boundaries, finger-zone/precision cutoffs, negative-consensus wording, endpoint-vs-length categorical overreach), not just the three flagged passages; no additional residual issue was found. Length and endpoint remain conceptually separate throughout (dedicated bullet plus FAQ answer, both reworded to avoid the categorical claim). Observation, Benham's named historical interpretation, and Palmistry Path's own editorial/safety policy remain in distinguishable sections, unchanged from revision 1.

tools_or_methods: Retrieved the full revision-1 article and supporting-file diff from the closed (unmerged) PR #77 branch claude/relay-PP-RELAY-044-long-heart-line-meaning, then applied exactly the three Director-specified corrections on top of it rather than redrafting from scratch
npm run audit:claim-risk as a bounded aid before and after the corrections
